facts.fact: In a masked Aadhaar the first 8 digits of the Aadhaar number are masked and only the last 4 digits are visible
facts.quote: In Masked Aadhaar, first 8 digits of Aadhaar number are masked and only last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number are visible.

facts.fact: The masked digits are shown as 'xxxx-xxxx'
facts.note: The 'xxxx-xxxx' wording is on the myAadhaar portal, which returns HTTP 500 to the checker's browser (28 Oct 2026); uidai.gov.in pages say only that the first 8 digits are masked.

facts.fact: Masked Aadhaar is available only in e-Aadhaar
facts.quote: Facility of Masked Aadhaar is available only in e-Aadhaar.

facts.fact: It is downloaded through the 'Download Masked Aadhaar' service, which needs a mobile OTP
facts.quote: Download Masked Aadhaar Only the last 4 digits of your Aadhaar number are visible Mobile OTP is required Free

facts.fact: Masked Aadhaar can also be downloaded in the Aadhaar App
facts.note: UIDAI's app FAQ lists 'download e-Aadhaar' among the app's services but does not say whether the masked option is offered in the app; a person must check the app (behind login).

facts.fact: Only the Aadhaar number is masked; name, photo, gender, date of birth, address and the QR code remain
facts.quote: In Masked Aadhaar, first 8 digits of Aadhaar number are masked and only last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number are visible.
facts.note: Derived: UIDAI describes masking only of the Aadhaar number; the other fields of the e-Aadhaar are not masked.

facts.fact: The Aadhaar QR code (present on e-Aadhaar) contains only the last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number, with name, address, gender, date of birth and photograph
facts.quote: It is present on all forms of Aadhaar like e-Aadhaar, Aadhaar letter, Aadhaar PVC card and Aadhaar App. It contains last 4 digits of Aadhaar number, name, address, gender, date of birth and photograph of the Aadhaar number holder.

facts.fact: UIDAI's current pages do not state that a masked Aadhaar must be accepted wherever a copy is demanded
facts.note: A claim of absence cannot be quoted. Searched uidai.gov.in FAQ pages (your-aadhaar, aadhaar-online-services, enrolment-and-update, my-aadhaar) on 28 Oct 2026: no statement that masked Aadhaar must be accepted.

facts.fact: UIDAI's FAQ says agencies that simply accept a physical copy without authentication/verification are not following good practice, citing MeitY OM 10(22)/2017-EG-II(VOL-1) dated 19.06.2023
facts.quote: There are many agencies that simply accept physical copy of Aadhaar and do not carry out any biometric or OTP authentication or verification. Is this a good practice? No, in this connection MeitY has issued detailed instructions to all Government Ministries/Departments vide office memorandum no 10(22)/2017-EG-II(VOL-1) dated 19.06.2023 .

facts.fact: e-Aadhaar, the Aadhaar letter and the PVC card are equally valid forms of Aadhaar
facts.quote: The different forms of Aadhaar are Aadhaar Letter, Aadhaar PVC card, eAadhaar which are equally valid and acceptable.

summary: Masking (first 8 digits, last 4 visible), e-Aadhaar only, OTP download, QR with last 4 digits, MeitY OM 19.06.2023 FAQ and equal validity confirmed; 'xxxx-xxxx', masked download in the app and the absence of an acceptance rule are manual.
